app.name: Dolbol
app.tagline: Plan the trip. Split the costs.
app.footer: Built for friend groups in Bangladesh • All amounts in whole BDT (৳)

createTrip.title: Create a trip
createTrip.subtitle: Enter trip name and your friends' names
createTrip.friendsNamesPlaceholder:
Karim, Tanvir, Nusrat
(or write one per line)
createTrip.friendsNamesHint: Separate names with commas (,), new lines, or 'and'. You can add more friends anytime later.

joinByLink.title: Join a trip
joinByLink.subtitle: Paste the shared trip link or code from your friend

whoAreYou.title: Join the trip
whoAreYou.subtitle: Tap your name to join with one click
whoAreYou.unclaimedPrompt: Tap your name below to join:
whoAreYou.reclaimHint: Switched device? Enter PIN to restore
whoAreYou.lockedNotice: This trip is locked. New members cannot join.
whoAreYou.claimConfirmBody: Someone already joined with this name. If this is you, continue. If someone else, go back and choose another name.

tripPage.inviteCardSubtitle: Send this link to friends on WhatsApp or Messenger (no login needed)
tripPage.pinOptionalHint: 4-6 digits; helps you reclaim your name and expenses if you switch phones
tripPage.lockTripHint: Locking prevents anyone from adding or editing expenses.
tripPage.confirmDeleteMemberDesc: Are you sure you want to remove this member? No expenses or repayments are linked to them.
tripPage.confirmResetDevicesDesc: All devices for this member will be signed out. They will have to claim their name again.
tripPage.newDeviceNotice: Your name was claimed from a new device ({time}). If this was not you, set a PIN or notify the creator.
tripPage.softPinPromptTitle: Why set a PIN? (What it does)
tripPage.softPinPromptBody: Dolbol has no passwords or accounts. Setting a 4-6 digit PIN ensures no one else can edit your expenses and lets you easily reclaim your profile if you switch devices.
tripPage.creatorPromptDesc: Set a 4-6 digit PIN now to protect creator actions like locking the trip and resetting member devices.
tripPage.creatorPinExplainerIntro: Dolbol requires no login or passwords. This 4-6 digit PIN protects your trip:
tripPage.creatorPinExplainerControl: Creator controls: Prevents others from locking the trip or deleting members.
tripPage.creatorPinExplainerRecovery: Device recovery: Reclaim your creator access if you switch phones or clear browser data.
tripPage.pinExplainerDesc: Dolbol requires no login or passwords. A 4-6 digit PIN prevents others from modifying your expenses and lets you reclaim your profile if you switch devices or clear browser cookies.
tripPage.pinExplainerIntro: Dolbol requires no login, email, or password. Setting a 4-6 digit PIN gives you two major benefits:
tripPage.pinExplainerSecurity: Expense security: Prevents anyone else from editing or deleting expenses under your name.
tripPage.pinExplainerRecovery: Easy recovery: If you switch phones or clear cookies, easily reclaim your profile in 1 tap.
tripPage.pinKeepCurrentHint: Leave blank to keep your current PIN, or enter new 4-6 digits to change
tripPage.pinEmptyOptionalHint: PIN is optional but recommended to protect your expenses
tripPage.offlineInternetRequiredDesc: Internet required, changes cannot be saved offline.
tripPage.clearOfflineDataLink: Clear this trip's data from this device
tripPage.clearOfflineDataConfirmDesc: The copy of this trip saved on this device will be removed and won't open offline. The trip itself is not deleted; you can open it again from the link.
tripPage.clearOfflineDataUnsyncedWarning: {count} expense(s) are not synced yet and will be lost
tripPage.clearOfflineDataSecondConfirmTitle: Unsynced expenses will be permanently lost. Are you sure you want to clear this trip's data?
tripPage.clearOfflineDataSuccess: ✓ This trip's offline data was cleared from this device

money.aiCardSubtitle: Type naturally in Bangla or Banglish, AI splits it automatically
money.aiInputPlaceholder: e.g., Dinner 1200 Karim paid everyone / hotel 5000 ami disi sobai
money.leftoverNote: Any rounding leftover (1–2 ৳) goes to the payer.
money.allSettled: Everyone is settled up! No pending debts.
money.settlementSubtitle: Record repayments directly between friends (kept separate from trip costs)
money.noExpensesYet: No expenses yet. Type an expense above and tap 'Add'.
money.duplicateWarningBody: Another expense with the same amount was already recorded today:
money.confirmDuplicateLabel: I confirm this is a separate expense (save anyway)
money.activityLogSubtitle: Permanent record of all expenses and changes

aiParser.cardSubtitle: Type naturally in Bangla or Banglish, AI splits it automatically
aiParser.inputPlaceholder: e.g.: shokaler nasta 250, CNG fare 450 (Karim paid), rater dinner 1200
aiParser.inputHelperText: 💡 Type naturally in Bangla or Banglish, you can review and edit details below.
aiParser.tryExamplesLabel: Tap a realistic example to try:
aiParser.confirmCardNote: Review the details below, edit if needed, then tap 'Confirm & Save'.
aiParser.errMissingAmount: No amount found (e.g., write 1200 tk or ১২০০ টাকা).
aiParser.errRateLimited: Too many requests! Please wait a moment and try again.
aiParser.errGeneric: Could not understand the message. Please try again or use the form below.
aiParser.fallbackNotice: Drafted with local parser, please review
aiParser.errLineTooLong: A single line cannot exceed 200 characters.
aiParser.unresolvedQuestionsWarning: Please resolve all questions before saving.
aiParser.undoFailed: Failed to undo, please try again.

planning.votingSubtitle: Where should we go? Propose options and vote
planning.noOptionsYet: Where to go? Add destination options for friends to vote on.
planning.itinerarySubtitle: Simple list of daily plans and schedule
planning.noItineraryYet: No itinerary yet. Add your day-by-day travel plans.
planning.activityNotesPlaceholder: e.g., Everyone be ready by 8 AM
planning.datesSubtitle: Set or update when your trip begins and ends
planning.invalidDatesError: End date cannot be earlier than start date.

shareExport.cardSubtitle: Download summary image card or export Excel cost sheet
shareExport.publicSummaryHint: Only shows destination and itinerary, zero expense details are revealed.
shareExport.costSheetHint: Full spreadsheet of daily expenses and who owes whom:
shareExport.privacyNotice: For privacy, money details are hidden on this public summary.

expenseDemo.ariaLabel: 10-second animation showing how to add and split expenses using AI
expenseDemo.cardSubtitle: Type naturally in Bangla or Banglish, AI will draft the expenses for you
expenseDemo.inputHelper: 💡 Type naturally in Bangla or Banglish, you can review and edit details below
expenseDemo.examplePrompt: Shokaler nasta 250, dupurer khabar 800, rater dinner 1200

errors.duplicate_name: A member with this name already exists! Add an initial or nickname.
errors.trip_not_found: No trip found with this link.
errors.trip_locked: This trip is locked and cannot be changed.
errors.not_creator: Only the trip creator can do this.
errors.invalid_amount: Amount must be a whole positive number (at least ৳ 1).
errors.same_member_settlement: Payer and receiver cannot be the same person.
errors.unauthorized: Please select your name to join the trip first.
errors.duplicate_expense_warning: An expense with this amount already exists today! Check 'Confirm' to save.
errors.cross_trip_option: This option belongs to another trip.
errors.duplicate_option: This destination option was already proposed!
errors.member_has_transactions: This member has recorded expenses or settlements and cannot be removed.
errors.cannot_delete_creator: The trip creator cannot be removed.

errors.invalid_dates: End date cannot be earlier than start date.

seo.homeTitle: Dolbol: Split trip costs with friends
seo.homeDescription: Type trip expenses in Bangla or Banglish, let AI split them into separate costs, and see who owes whom. No login needed.
seo.joinTripDescBase: Join with your name, no login needed. Trip expenses in one place.
seo.joinTripDescWithDest: You're invited to {destination} trip. Join with your name, no login needed. Trip expenses in one place.
seo.summaryDesc: View trip expenses and who owes whom at a glance.
